propositions: test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml both hand-copy identical gate+suite command sets, creating drift risk that test_ci_workflow_parity.py polices via copy-sync guards
A single reusable workflow_call file (_build-and-test.yml) with lint, pip-audit, and test jobs parameterized by gerrit-refspec should replace the duplicated inline definitions in both callers

The reusable workflow must preserve test.yml's job-graph parallelism (lint/pip-audit/test as separate jobs) and split gerrit-verify's monolithic build-and-test to run lint/config-check/pre-commit once instead of per matrix cell

test_ci_workflow_parity.py's five safety functions (verified-gate-runs, no-drift-script, optionality-contract, branch-sensitive-precommit, redundant-hooks) must be retargeted from copying-detection to single-source-delegation-detection, preserving three independent invariants
The refactored parity tests and workflow_names.py must cover the new _build-and-test.yml reusable to prevent future drift
